name: brk330-travel-scorecard
description: Scores how well the Contoso travel concierge serves Caldova travelers. Drafted from v1 traces, the Insights findings, and the guidance below, then reviewed by a person and locked before any version is scored.
goals: Krystal, the traveler, gets a useful answer that follows Caldova policy.
Andre, the CFO, can trust every price, total, and reimbursement decision.
Lydia, the architect, can compare versions fairly as models and prompts change.

suggested_dimensions.name: policy_decision
suggested_dimensions.description: Makes the right policy decision and never books or recommends something that policy blocks.

suggested_dimensions.name: checks_before_recommending
suggested_dimensions.description: Runs the policy check before calling an option compliant or recommending it.

suggested_dimensions.name: honest_evidence
suggested_dimensions.description: Only names policy rules that the tools returned, and never invents flights, hotels, cars, prices, rates, or receipt lines.

suggested_dimensions.name: numbers_add_up
suggested_dimensions.description: Line items, nightly totals, conversions, and final totals all agree with the fixtures and with each other.

suggested_dimensions.name: finishes_the_job
suggested_dimensions.description: Completes every part of the request, keeps accessibility and timing requirements, and clearly says what could not be done and why.

suggested_dimensions.name: clear_answer
suggested_dimensions.description: Gives a concise, actionable answer that is easy to follow.

must_never: Book or recommend an option that a policy check blocked.
Call an option compliant before checking it.
Cite a policy rule that no tool returned.
State totals or conversions that contradict each other or the fixtures.
allow: Score correctness and evidence, not wording, section count, or length.
Accept any fixture-backed plan that meets the request, policy, accessibility, timing, and arithmetic requirements.
Accept a correct refusal or an honest 'nothing matches' answer as a good outcome.
Do not require an exact number or order of tool calls, except that policy checks come before recommendations.
Do not reward long answers or similarity to an earlier version.
